source: City of SeaTac municipal GIS Building Footprints
sourceStatement: Building height information was calculated from 2016 LIDAR data to be used as a starting point for 3D modeling, and has been refined in a few target areas, but is mostly unverified.

fieldDefinitions.BldgHeight: The maximum height of the building.
fieldDefinitions.EaveHeight: The minimum height of the building. Buildings with no eave height have flat roofs.
fieldDefinitions.FloorCount: The number of floors above ground level.

coordinateUnit: Foot_US, EPSG:2926; the coordinate unit alone does not establish the separate numeric height-field unit.
heightAttributeUnit: Not explicitly confirmed in the retrieved field definitions.
application: Not applied. No municipal footprint replaces an OSM footprint; no height, eave, roof form, floor count or ground datum is forced from this layer. Current source identity, acquisition date and height-unit validation would be required before using individual records.
limitation: Compiled style estimates remain estimates. The existence of this mostly unverified candidate layer is not evidence that the unknown heights are measured or verified.
